title: FlexTradeRow
description: optionledger.flex_trade_row r1: one revision of one Flex trade row of level EXECUTION, attributes as sent, as text; insert only. No account number is stored: the alias is the only identity.

alias.description: Account alias of the row, the label mapped by the allow-list.

level_of_detail.description: Level of detail of the Flex row, for example EXECUTION.

transaction_id.description: Flex transactionID of the row, as text.

revision.description: Revision of the row for its transaction; 1 for a new key, a changed row is the next revision.

fetch_id.description: Identifier of the fetch record that brought the row; for an import, the identifier of the import.

row_index.description: Position of the row in its report.

source.description: Writer of the row: flex for a fetch, ot_import for the import of option-trader history.

attributes.description: JSON object as text: every attribute of the Trade row as sent, every value text.

attributes_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the attributes text, 64 lower-case hex digits.

recorded_at.description: Instant the row was recorded, UTC.
